Application Data.NAME: Tony's Deli
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Tony's Deli is a delicatessen and sandwich shop specializing in fresh, high-quality sandwiches, salads, and artisanal deli meats. We focus on offering a diverse menu with a commitment to food safety and exceptional customer service. Our operations include preparing made-to-order sandwiches and salads using household-type appliances such as toasters and panini presses, ensuring minimal fire risk. We prioritize proper refrigeration and handling of all perishable items to mitigate spoilage and contamination risks. With a dedicated staff trained in food safety protocols, we aim to provide a safe environment for both employees and customers while maintaining a revenue target of less than $500,000 annually.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a refrigeration unit malfunctioned, resulting in spoilage of $1,200 worth of deli meats and cheeses. The claim is currently under review with the equipment manufacturer for potential reimbursement.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols conducted during late hours and a chain-link fence surrounding the premises.
